༄༅/ /dam chos dgongs pa yab zab las:tshe'i dbang po 'dzin pa'i bla ma gsang ba'i sgrub thabs kyi las gzhung bzhugs so:

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dam chos dgongs pa yab zab las: tshe'i dbang po 'dzin pa'i bla ma gsang ba'i sgrub thabs kyi las gzhung bzhugs so:

mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa 'khor rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo: o rgyan gyi ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs kyis mnag pa man ngag yang tig gsang ba bla na med pa'i yang zhun/ bde gshegs thugs kyi snying po/ rig 'dzin gyi tshe sgrub/ yang gsang bla na med pa'i mkha' spyod/ dgongs pa'i zhe phugs mthar thug pa/ yang tig snying po 'bru gcig gi sgrub thabs yang bcud/ gud du bkod pa 'di'i phrin las kyi rim pa ni/ dam pa'i chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi dkyil 'khor du/ dbang lung legs par thob pa'i gang zag gis sgrub gnas phun sum tshogs pa rnams su/ dpal gyi gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba'i dbyibs can zur gsum pa/ dbal gsum rim gyis zur du pad chung re re dang*/ steng du zan gru gsum gyi steng du nor bu gsum sgron can/ mtha' pad+ma'i 'dab ma gyen la brgyad kyi mtshams su ril bu re re/ dbyibs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa'i rtser bris sku dang gdugs dmar pos brgyan pa'i g.yas su sman/ g.yon du rak+ta/ mdun du mchod pa/ gzhan yang tshogs rdzas sha zan chang la sogs pa dang*/ chad mdo'i gtor ma zur gsum can gsum thun mong du mtheb skyu gcig gis g.yogs pa dang*/ brtan ma'i gtor ma bshos zlum gcig gi phyogs bzhir pad chung sum brtsegs re re yod pa de gnyis ka sha khrag gis sbags pa rnams bshams/ 'di'i bgegs gtor ni bshos zlum rtsa bar ting lo dang mtheb skyu'i steng du ril bu bzhag pa changs bu dang bcas pa re/ mdor na 'di'i dpal gtor/ chad mdo/ brtan skyong*/ bgegs gtor rnams lha brag ma'i thugs sgrub 'bring po kho na ltar bya'o// gzhan yang rnga sil la sogs rol mo'i bye brag dang*/ bris sku rten rdzas la sogs pa bshams/ slob ma rjes 'dzin byed na/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dbang la mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'du byas la|

sgrub pa po stan bde bar kha lho nub tu phyogs pas/ phrin las kyi rim par 'jug pa'i tshul ni gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo// dang po sngon 'gro'i sdom la ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag bdun// bka' bsgo mtshams bcad bshags pa dang*// mchod pa sman raka gtor byin rlabs// byin rlabs bcu gcig sngon 'gro'i las// zhes pa ltar/ dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ hūm̐ */ rang rig rang shar pad+ma drag po rtsal: dus gsum rgyal ba gcig bsdus o rgyan rje: rang sems spros bral rtsa gsum zhi khro la: gnyis med spang ba'i gus pas skyabs su mchi: zhes lan gsum: sems bskyed pa ni: rang rig gdod nas yongs grub thugs kyi lha: ma rig kun btags dbang gyur 'gro ba rnams: skad cig bsgral phyir gu ru pad+ma yi: go 'phang bsgrub la 'bad phyir sems bskyed do: zhes gsum dang bdun rnam dag ni: hūm̐ */ thugs kyi lha tshogs 'dir gshegs dgyes par bzhugs: gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul: sdig sgrib mthol bshags dge la rjes yi rang : don dam chos gsung bskul zhing 'gro ba rnams: thar pa ma thob bar du bzhugs su gsol: dus gsum bsags yod dge rnams rdzogs byang bsngo: 'bras bu bla ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog: ces gsum bya: bgegs gtor spyi 'gro ltar byin brlabs nas bsngos la: bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐ */ rang rig bla ma chos kyi sku: gzung 'dzin sems kyi 'khrul pa yi: ltar snang bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs: blo brid gtor ma 'di khyer la: rang rang gnas su myur du dengs: gal te mi 'gro nyams par bgyi: zhes gtor ma phyir bskyal: hūm̐ sgra sgrog cing suṃ bha'i sngags brjod: mtshams bcad pa ni: hūm̐ */ bdag nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: 'jigs byed pad+ma drag po rtsal: dmar nag sku las rab 'phros pa'i: khro bo khro mo sprul pa'i tshogs: bskal pa'i me ltar rab 'bar ba'i:

bar chad bdud dang dam sri bgegs: ming yang med par brlags nas kyang : phyogs mtshams khro bo'i gur du gyur: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rak+ṣaṃ pra kā ra pañja ra bi tā na rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: ces mtshams bcad bshags pa ni: hūm̐ */ dus gsum bde gshegs mkha' 'gro dam can dgongs: bdag gis bskal pa sngon nas da lta'i bar: dug lnga'i dbang gyur ngan song gsum gyi las: lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: zhes yi ge brgya pa brjod: phyi mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐ */ ar+ghaṃ bdug spos me tog mar me dang : dri chab phyi mchod 'dzin pa'i lha mo lnga: mdzes pa'i tshul 'chang rnam dag mchod tshogs kyis: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mnyes par byed: oṃ ā ha ra sarba bid+yā dha ra pū dzi te hūm̐ oṃ: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ zhes dang*/ sman mchod byin brlab ni: hūm̐ */ mtshan ldan thod pa rigs lnga yab yum bcu: sbyar ba'i mkha' la bdud rtsi mu tig ltar: bab pas yongs bkang rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sman: dri med rnam dag bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur: ces dang : oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta bo dhi tsit+ta hā ru bi shud+dha hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes 'dzab dbyangs gsum bya: rak+ta byin brlab ni: hūm̐ */ lcang lor bcas pa'i bhan+dha yangs pa ru: 'khor ba bsgral ba'i 'dod chags rak+ta mchog: rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa'i rtsa chen spros: yum gyi thig le chos nyid skye ba med: ces dang : bh+rūṃ bhan+dha rak+ta sa man+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes gsum brjod: gtor ma byin brlab ni: hūm̐: snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad gtor ma'i snod: 'bru sna rin chen sna tshogs gtor ma'i rgyu: dkar gsum mngar gsum sha rus gtor ma'i rgyan: byin gyis brlabs pa ye shes ngo bor gyur: ces dang : oṃ rat+na trāṃ oṃ ba ling+ta te dz+wa ba ling+ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ye swā hā:

zhes gsum brjod: byin dbab pa ni: gu gul tshil chen sbyar ba'i spos sreg cing : hūm̐ */ chos sku skye med ngang nas thugs rjes bzhengs: 'gro ba'i don mdzad sku gsum bla ma rnams: bdag nyid sdig sgrib dag pa'i phung po la: lha rnams dgyes shing 'od zer stong gsum gang : bdag la thim pas yi dam lhar gyur te: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob pa yi: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub byin phob cig: sa ma ya sid+dhi kā ya wāka tsit+ta hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes byin brlabs/ de rnams sngon 'gro'i las rim bcu gcig go// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum 'byung rim gzhal yas gdan khri lha bskyed spyan drangs bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal zhing: phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka gtor ma phyag rgya gar dang sbyor sgrol mchod pa 'bul: bstod cing 'dzab bstod 'dzab bzlas rdzogs rim ste: dngos gzhi sdom ni nyi shu tham pa'o: de yang ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: hūm̐ */ ma bcos spros bral rig rtsal chos kyi dbyings: de ltar ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams: snying po rtsal gyi 'od lnga 'dus pa'i rgyu: hūm̐ chen dmar po nyi zla ltar 'bar ba: skar chen thang la bab pa ji bzhin shar: 'byung rim ni: de la 'od 'phros e yaṃ raṃ baṃ suṃ: laṃ las nam mkha' rlung me chu dang sa: ri rab dang bcas 'og nas 'byung rim chags: e yaṃ raṃ baṃ suṃ laṃ maṇ+ḍal badz+ra gar+bha hūm̐: gzhal yas gdan bcas bskyed pa ni: hūm̐ */ 'byung ba rnam lnga ri rab bcas pa'i steng : bh+rūṃ las rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs chos 'khor tog: rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu dra ba dang : shar bu mda' yab la sogs kun ldan pa'i: ye shes las byung phyi nang med pa'i dal: de ltar pad+ma rdo rje me ri gur: phyi rol dur khrod brgyad ldan gzhal yas kyi: dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba dang : nyi ma'i gdan bcas 'od zer 'bar ba'i steng :

bdud bzhi srin po pho mo gan rkyal dbus: lha bskyed ni: rang rig hūm̐ dmar las byung rdo rje'i sku: ma hā gu ru pad+ma drag po rtsal: sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs pa'i cha byad can: gsung gdangs rngam pa'i nga ro hūm̐ sgra sgrog: thugs nyid nyon mongs bdud bgegs bag la nyal: sgrol ba'i ngar bcas bsgyings bag rol pa'i stabs: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu gdengs: g.yon pa dngul dkar dril bu dku la brten: khro 'dzum brjid chags gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: ye shes spyan gsum nyi zla'i 'od lta bur: sdang mig phyogs bcur g.yo bas bgegs tshogs bsregs: tshems phreng gangs ri ltar gtams bzhad pa'i phreng : smin ma sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar: dbu skra thor gtsug rus rgyan 'khor los spras: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbu yi rgyan du byas: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis sku la brgyan: za 'og ber steng rin chen ska rags bcings: de steng dmar ljang phod chen lhug par mnabs: yan lag mdo bzhi sprul gyi chun pos brgyan: brkyang bskum dor stabs tshul gyis rab tu bzhengs: khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum zil gyis gnon: dus gsum rgyal dang rtsa gsum zhi khro'i lha: dbyer med o rgyan drag po'i sku ru gsal: phyi 'khor yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs: char sprin lta bur mngon sum bzhugs par gyur: de nas spyan 'dren ni: spos bsreg rol mo'i tshogs dang bcas te: gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do: hūm̐ */ bzhengs shig pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: le'u bdun ma ltar/ phaṭa kyi sgra skad drag po sangs se sang : gnas 'dir byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya staṃ: sa ma ya hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ sa ma ya hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs: bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ */ byin gyis brlabs pa'i pho brang dam pa 'dir:

bdud bzhi pad+ma nyi zla'i khri steng du: ma hā gu ru pad+ma drag po rtsal: bdag la dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya ā we sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐ */ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa: pad+ma drag po rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes phyag 'tshal: phyi'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐ */ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: mchod yon bdug spos me tog dang : mar me dri chab la sogs pa'i: lha rdzas phyi mchod 'bul gyi bzhes: oṃ ā ha ra sarba bid+yā dha ra pū dzi te puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye pū dza hoḥ nang mchod ni: hūm̐ */ dbang po'i me tog tshil chen spos: zhun chen mar me dri chu dang : dri chen bshos dang thod pa'i rnga: rang byung nang mchod 'bul gyi bzhes: ma hā sarba pū dza hoḥ gsang mchod ni: hūm̐ */ pad+ma can sogs phyag rgya lnga: sgyu rtsal drug cu bzhir mkhas pa: 'dod pa'i don stsol yid 'ong ma: sprul pa'i lha mo mchod par 'bul: pradz+nyā dz+nyā na pū dza hoḥ sman mchod ni: hūm̐ */ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar 'chi med bcud: rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos: nyon mongs dug lnga sel byed sman: 'bul gyi bdag la mchog stsol cig: sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: zhes 'bul zhing rang gis kyang myong : rak+ta'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐ */ skra dang bcas pa'i bhan+dha ru: rgyu gnyis rkyen gsum rab sbyar ba'i: rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba 'di: 'bul gyi 'dod chags sbyang du gsol: ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: gtor ma'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐ */ snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: srid pa bcud kyi sems can gtor mar bcas: 'bru bcud sman raka sha rus sgog btsong spos: 'dod yon lnga ldan ma tshang med tshogs pas: ting 'dzin dgongs rgyud dag pas byin brlabs te: bdud rtsi sbyar ba'i gtor ma chen po 'dis:

rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskang gyur cig: yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: mkha' 'gro dpa' bo thugs dam bskang gyur cig: dam can srung ma'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ma hā ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: phyag rgya gar mchod ni: hūm̐ */ pad+ma drag po'i lha tshogs la: sna tshogs 'dod dgur sgyur byed cing : brda dang gar gyis rab mtshon pa'i: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul: oṃ badz+ra mu dra narta pū dza hoḥ sbyor mchod ni: hūm̐ */ mkha' dbyings byin rlabs byas pa yi: yab yum gnyis med sbyor ba yi: bde ba stong pa'i rang bzhin can: dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul bar bgyi: ma hā a nu rā ga pū dza hoḥ drag po'i sgrol mchod ni: hūm̐ */ che mchog pad+ma drag po rtsal: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu gdengs: phyag g.yon phur bus dgra snying gzer: bka' srung pho nya mang po yi: ngar 'dzin dgra bgegs sgrol byed rnams: myur du khug la drag pos sgrol: thal bar rlog la chos nyid kyi: thugs rje yangs pa'i klong du bstim: ma hā sha trūṃ mā ra ya pū dza hoḥ zhes mchod bstod pa ni: rngam pa'i dbyangs dang bcas pas: hūm̐ */ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: bdud bzhi gdan du bsgyel ba'i khri steng du: pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan steng na: ma hā gu ru pad+ma drag po rtsal: sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu gdengs: phyag g.yon dngul gyi dril bu dku la brten: dbu skra thor tshugs dur khrod rus pas brgyan: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbu yi rgyan du bzhugs: spyan gsum nyi zla lta bur 'khyil zhing gzigs: thugs nyid drag po'i ngar ldan thog ltar myur: smin ma sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar: zhal gdangs mche ba gangs ri lta bur gtsigs: rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar 'u ru ru: rin chen rus rgyan sbrul gyi gdub bus brgyan: za 'og ber lcang brjid pa'i na bza' gsol:

bsgying bag rol pa'i stangs stabs mdzad de bzhugs: khro gtum gar dgu ldan pa'i dpa' bo che: pad+ma drag po rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ */ 'khor lo lnga yi gnas rnams mkha' 'gros gang : sku yi gnas brgyad khrag 'thung khro bos gang : lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin dbu la bzhugs: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin thugs kar bzhugs: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin 'khor du bskor: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ */ dam can bka' srung thams cad bran du 'khor: dregs pa'i lha srin srog rtsa snying nas 'dren: bdud dang dam sri log 'dren rdul du rlog: 'jigs byed drag po rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod/ 'dzab bstod bya ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes drag po sgrog pa ni// snang srid lha 'dre 'jig rten rmang nas ldeg /'ur 'ur chem chem kun nas g.yo zhing 'gul// rmi lam nang rtags dngos grub bsam mi khyab// mngon sum rtags ni chos nyid gsal dag rtogs// chos nyid rang byung rang gsal rgyud la 'char// khro gtum nga rgyal dgra bgegs bdud tshogs rnams// bar chad gdug pa'i gdon tshogs thal bar rlogs// 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin dngos grub thob// ces 'dzab bstod/ slar 'dzab bzlas ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas lus phyi nang*// hūm̐ gis gang zhing nang du ma shong bar// phyir 'phros stong gsum 'jig rten hūm̐ gis gang*// de las hrīḥzhes brjod pas hūm̐ yig rnams// mkha' 'gro mar gyur steng 'og yongs gang nas// de rnams zhal nas hūm̐ sgra dir ri sgrog /phyi nang gsang gsum bde gshegs byang sems dang*// skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal snang srid kyi// lha 'dre gnod byed la sogs bdag nyid kyi// tshe srog bar gcod bgegs kyang mkha' 'gror gyur// de rnams zhal nas hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog /slar yang bdag gi mgrin nang hūm̐ dmar po// byi ru ltar gsal hūm̐ zhes drag brjod pas// mkha' 'gro thams cad bro rdung gar stabs su// shigs shigs stong gsum ri rab bcas pa yang*// ldeg ldeg bdag gi dbang du 'dus par gyur// ces de lta bu'i rang bzhin gsal ba'i ma yeng bar drag po'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/

zhag bdun du ngag bcad de bsnyen pa hūm̐ la bya'o// de ltar bzlas pa'i tshul 'di gter gzhung nas// dkyil 'khor rnam gsum man ngag gcig du dril// nyams len gsal stong 'dzin med ngang nyid la// khams gsum zil gnon bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsal// nyams nga bag tsha rnam rtog cham gyis bskyur// zhen 'khris chags sdang rtsa ba rbad kyis bcad// brtul zhugs drag pos srin po'i ngar dbyangs dang*// gtum drag rdo rje gtum po'i ngar dbyangs bcas// hūm̐ sgra brtsegs ma ngar ldan thog ltar bzlas// dal bar bzlas na 'brug dbyangs ldir ba ltar// dal khug ngur sgra dkyus su phab la bzlas// zhes pa ltar bzla'o// bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad ni gter gzhung las/ nyin zhag re la thugs kyi snying po 'di// nyi khri chig stong sngon du bsnyen pa'i gnad// ces gsungs pas/ nyams len rgyun 'khyer gyi tshad kyang*/ nyi ma re re la hūm̐ yig nyi khri chig stong bzla dgos par gsungs so// de ltar bzlas pa'i phan yon brtag pa ni/ gter gzhung las/ de ltar bzlas pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab| |rmi lam nang rtags slob dpon zhal mthong zhing*// gsung thos gdams pa'i gnad khrid thob pa dang*// phung po zag med rdo rje'i lus su 'gyur// phyi nang bar chad bdud rnams rab 'joms zhing*// yi dam nus pa'i rtags tshad mngon du 'gyur// bde gshegs zhal mthong mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan 'byung*// chos nyid skye med lhag mthong rgyud la 'char// nyams myong dam chos kun la rang byan tshud// chos sku kun bzang thig ler rdzogs pa dang*// longs sku 'od phung mtshan dang dpe byad ldan// sprul sku sems can gang la gang 'dul 'byung*// yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen sa non zhing*// dngos sam nyams su ye shes ḍā ki'i lus// yid bzhin nor ltar mchod cing bskur bar byed// snang srid lha 'dres bka' nyan srog snying phul// zhes pa lta bu'i mtshan ma ma mthong bar du bzla'o// gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa bya tshul ni/

gter gzhung las/ gnyid log dus su snying gar hūm̐ bsgoms nas// de la rig pa gtad de 'phror mi gzhug /hūm̐ yig rtsa yi 'phar grangs bsnyen pa 'grub// nyi khri chig stong zhag gcig bsnyen grangs rdzogs// ngal gso'i dus su rtsa bral ngang du bzhag /de ltar bsgoms la le lo rab spangs te// brtson pa drag pos sgrub dang dngos grub nye// nyams len bar med rig pa dwangs snyigs 'byed// ces pa ni mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor dang*/ nyin kun tu sems bzhag thabs ni/ gter gzhung las/ sems kyi rang bzhin chos nyid dkyil 'khor ni// thugs dgongs brjod bral mkha' dbyings rnam par dag /rang byung rang shar stong gsal 'dzin pa med// skye med ka dag zang thal gnas lugs la// gzung 'dzin zhen pa'i thag pa bcad la bzhag /de ltar shes na kun gyi srog rtsa zin// snang srid lha 'dre kun gyi spyi srog yin// 'gro drug skye 'gro kun gyi rnam shes yin// dus gsum rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i thugs dgongs yin// gsang sngags ma lus kun gyi khong snying yin// zhes pa de lta bur rdzogs rim gnad dang ldan pa'i ngang du nyams su blang ngo*// gsum pa mjug gi sdom ni/ tshogs byin gyis rlabs spyan drang ni// tshogs 'bul bskang bshags bsgral mchod bya// longs spyod lhag gtor thugs dam bskul// chad mdo brtan skyong rta bro dang*// dngos grub blang zhing gshegs la bsdu// smon lam shis brjod mjug gi sdom// zhes pa ltar bcu bdun la/ dang po tshogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gter gzhung las/ de nas dngos grub blang bar bya ba ni// dngos po'i nor rdzas tshogs kyi mchod par bsham// zhes pa ltar/ tshogs rdzas ma tshang ba med pa bshams nas/ chu gtsang bran te/ oṃ u tsuṣ+ma bai tā lī kro dha ni sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ */ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs las 'od 'phros pas// 'jig rten khams kyi 'dod yon ma lus dang*// 'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal yon phun tshogs dang*// rtsi sman 'bru dang rin chen bcud thams cad// skad cig bsdus te tshogs rdzas so sor bstims// zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs// oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐:

hūm̐ hūm̐ nā nā khā de sid+dhi me bha ba hrī: ā yuḥsid+dhi sa ma ya 'dus 'dus: zhes byin brlabs la/ tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ */ ma hā gu ru pad+ma drag po rtsal// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bka' srung dang*// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i 'khor gyis rab bskor bas// 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ sa ma ya gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī hūm̐ dza dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs nas/ de nas tshogs phud cha gsum du spros pas/ dang po 'bul zhing sman raka bsgron la/ hūm̐ */ bza' bca' btung ba bshos dang 'dod yon lnga// ro drug btung bar bcas pa'i 'dod yon rnams// bla ma rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// mchog thun tshe dbang dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ga ṇa pū dza khā hi: zhes dbul/ bar pa bskang zhing bshags pa ni/ hūm̐ */ 'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs kyi longs spyod 'di// o rgyan pad+ma drag rtsal thugs dam bskang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro'i ma tshogs thugs dam bskang*// bskangs gyur dbang dang tshe'i dngos grub stsol// ces dang bshags pa ni/ hūm̐ */ bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur pas// dam 'gal sdig bsags log lta nongs gyur tshogs// 'gyod pas bshags so bzod par myur bzhes la// tshangs par tshe dbang dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes dang*/ yi ge brgya pas bshags so// tha mar bsgral mchod ni/ zan la dgra bgegs kyi rū pa bcos pa dang tshogs kyi sha zan dum bu la rak+ta bran/ dgug gzhug byas la/ dgug pa ni/ hūm̐ */ dpal chen thugs las rab sprul pa'i// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// pho nya 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// dgra bgegs bla srog myur du khug /a mu kaṃ sha trūṃ nṛ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa ā we sha ya hoḥ zhes 'gugs shing lha dang phral la/ phur bu lag tu sgril zhing*/

hūm̐ */ sgrol byed chen po ging gi tshogs// mtshon cha sna tshogs char du phob// dgra bgegs nyon mongs 'khor ba'i rgyu// gzugs phung rdul du rlog par gyis// du tri a mu kaṃ trika nan: myag hur thuṃ dza mā ra ya rbad: ces bsgral nas gtor mar stob cing sman raka sgron la/ hūm̐ */ 'jigs byed pad+ma drag po rtsal// bzhad pa'i zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs// dgra bgegs 'khor ba las sgrol phyir// gzugs snang sdom pa'i sha khrag dang*// bag chags rtog pa ma lus pa// dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di// zhal du bstab po kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā maṃ sa/ rak+ta/ go ro tsa na/ keṃ ni ri ti/ ba su ta bhak+ṣa/ bhuñja tha/ pi ba tha kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes 'bul/ de nas/ hūm̐ */ bde gshegs lhag ma dngos grub zag med rdzas// spyad pas mchog thun tshe dbang dpal 'byor dang*// zhi rgyas dbang drag dngos grub ma lus pa// ma thogs 'bad med dus 'dir bstsal du gsol// zhes dang*/ gong gi tshogs byin rlabs kyi sngags 'di nyid 'dzab dbyangs su bzla zhing*/ tshogs rdzas de dngos grub tu rol/ de ma 'grog la lhag ma bsdus pa slob dpon gyi zhal chu dang sman raka bran/ dpal 'bar btsugs la/ oṃ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐ */ dang po phud bdag bla ma yi dam lha// bar du tshogs bdag mkha' 'gro'i ma tshogs dang*// tha mar lhag sdud bran dang pho nya'i tshogs// dbang phyug ging dang ma mo gnod sbyin dang*// 'bar ma pho nya laṅka sde dpon tshogs// 'dir byon phud tshogs lhag ma la sogs pa// gcig bsres chos nyid rgyu 'bras gcig phyir bzhes// hūm̐ */ pho nya 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// dgra dang bgegs kyi srog rtsa chod/ las la grub cing shugs la 'gro// gnas bzang dur khrod khyab par nyul// gos bzang g.yang gzhi lus la gyon// zas bzang tshogs mchod gtor ma za// skyogs bzang bhan+dha lag na thogs// skyems bzang rak+ta zhal du gsol// dam tshig srung mar mchod pa'i tshe// rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis mkha' la 'gro// zas su sha dang khrag la dga'// las su gsod dang gcod la brtson// bka' yi pha 'bab 'di longs la// dpal chen khrag 'thung bka' la nyon// 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi'i sgo chod la// ye shes bzhi yi lam ston cig

/dgra bgegs gnod byed zlog cig sgrol// mthun phyogs tshe dpal 'byor tshogs spel// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces gtsang sar 'bul/ slob ma rjes 'dzin 'dod na skabs 'dir 'bad de/ ji skad du lha brag ma'i rtsa tho la/ cho ga'i bar thems bstan pa ni// srung 'khor mtshams bcad dag dang 'brel// gsol 'debs 'dzab dang 'brel bar bya// dbang bskur tshogs dang 'brel ba ni// rab gnas sbyin sreg gnas spor dang*// zhi rgyas dbang drag las gang byed// tshogs 'bul sham bur 'dogs pa gces// gzhung nas ma gsal gzhan na snang*// rdo rje slob dpon gtso chen gyi// thugs la bstim zhing sa ma ya// zhes gzhung du mi gsal ba'i las tshogs rnams skabs thob tu shes dgos pa la| skabs 'dir dbang bskur ba ni/ bris sku/ hūm̐ dmar/ shel rdo/ 'khor lo/ hūm̐ kha dog lnga ldan rnams nyer bsdogs bya/ tshes bcu 'am nyer lnga'i dus bzang la/ las byang tshogs lhag yan grub rjes/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar/ slob dpon gyis bdag 'jug blangs/ de nas slob mas yon 'bul/ khrus nas dbyung zhing*/ me tog bkram zhing bsdus la bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor sgom/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas pus btsugs thal mo sbyar zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob mas/ kye/ bla ma gu ru sprul pa'i sku| |sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*// phrin las chen po 'gro ba'i don// gdul bya rgyas par mdzad du gsol// bdag 'dra dad pa'i slob bu rnams// thugs rje chen pos gzung du gsol| |zhes gsol/ slob dpon gyis lan sbyin pa ni/ kye hoḥ ma hā gu ru nus pa'i dbang*// rigs kyi bu la sbyin par bya// snyigs ma'i sems can dug lnga rags// de yi dbang gyur ngan song ltung*| |rkyen rnams bar chad byed pa yi// dam tshig nyams na gnyis ka brlag /lus srog bral la thug gyur kyang*// dam tshig bsrung na dbang bskur sbyin// zhes dam bsgrags/

skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ yan lag bdun pa rnams las gzhung ltar bya/ mngon rtogs ltar dmigs pa sprad la/ ye shes pa spyan drang ba'i slad du/ bzhengs shig pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ sogs spyan 'dren gyis byin dbab/ ye shes pa mi nyams pa'i slad du/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang*/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas btab/ dbang dngos gzhi'i don du slob mas/ 6666 brgyud pa'i rtsa ba bla ma rje// dngos grub rtsa ba yi dam lha// bar chad kun sel mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rtsa gsum bla ma'i byin gyi rlabs// skal ldan bdag la bstsal du gsol// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon gyis bris sku spyi bor bzhag bum chu khar sbyin zhing*/ oṃ| bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma drag po rtsal// gzi brjid 'od 'phro mtshan dang dpe byad ldan// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// bdag cag lus kyi nyes pa sbyang du gsol| |oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes bskur/ dbang don spyi ltar bshad/ mgrin par hūm̐ yig gtad cing bdud rtsi khar sbyin/ āḥ sgra yi snying po kun 'dus yi ge hūm̐// drag las ngar ldan gdangs chen sgra yi mchog /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// 'chal ba ngag gi nyes pa sbyang du gsol// gong gi sngags sham du/ wāka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes bskur/ dbang don spyi ltar bshad/ shel rdo snying khar gtad cing*/ hūm̐ */ bde gshegs ma lus thugs kyi snying po ni/ ma bcos rang byung gsal 'tsher skyon dang bral/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// 'khrul pa yid kyi nyes pa sbyang du gsol// gong gi sngags sham du/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hū?m̐/ zhes bskur/ dbang don spyi ltar bshad/ 'khor lo lte bar gtad la/ swā/ 'dod pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs rin po che/ kun la dbang byed 'khor lo 'bar ba yi/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// 'dzin byed zhe sdang nyes pa sbyang du gsol// gong gi sngags sham du/

gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñca swā/ zhes bskur/ dbang don spyi ltar bshad/ hūm̐ lnga yan lag lnga la gtad la/ hā/ rgyal ba'i mdzad pa phrin las stobs po che// phrin las rnam bzhi gang la gang 'dul ston// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// dug lnga nyes pa'i phung po sbyang du gsol// gong gi sngags sham du/ karma a bhi ṣiñca hā/ zhes bskur/ dbang don spyi ltar bshad/ gtor ma slob ma'i mgor bzhag sman raka khar sbyin la/ hūm̐ */ snod bcud rnam dag sman raka gtor mar bcas// dgos pa kun 'byung bla ma mchod pa'i rdzas// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// thugs rje'i gdul bya phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /gong gi sngags sham du/ pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ba ling+ta sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes bskur/ de nas slob bus phyag bya/ bla ma'i zhabs la btud dam tshig gsum la gnas par khas blangs shing*/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa mi bcag par gzung du gzhug /de nas khas len pa'i ched du/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa// sogs gsum gyis dam tshig bsrung bar khas len du bcug cing*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo// de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni/ gtor mar sman raka bran la/ hūm̐ */ rang byung 'od lnga 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas// rigs kyi bla ma tshe dbang 'chi med rtsal// snying rje'i mdangs la pad+ma drag po bzhengs// 'bad rtsol gdung bas thugs dam bskul lags kyi// ngar 'dzin nyon mongs bdud dang dgra bgegs tshogs// skad cig tshar gcod skye med ngang du sgrol// rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du grol nas kyang*// sku gsum 'bras bu mchog la rab tu sbyor// thugs dam dus las ma g.yel sa ma ya/ zhes bskur/ chad mdo'i gtor ma phyir spags la sman raka bran/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ sngon dang bar pa rtsod ldan dus gsum du// 'og min bsam yas zangs mdog dpal gyi rir// dbang chen pad+ma saṃ bha thod phreng gis// rgyud bshad dbang bskur gsang sngags rgya dkrol tshe// bka' srung dam can ma mo gza' rdor legs// gter bdag bcas pas rang rang gzugs bstan cing*// bka' yi gtor ma len cing phrin las rnams// 'bad med bsgrub pa'i tha tshig ma chad dam// ji ltar dam dgongs gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag la 'tshe ba'i bar gcod sol// mthun pa'i phyogs sgrubs bcol ba'i las mdzod cig

/oṃ dharma pā la tri ādz+nyā rak+ṣa ni dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥsarba pañca a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ba ling+ta bhak+ṣa pi ba tha karma ku ru hoḥ zhes gtsang sar 'bul/ brtan ma'i gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs/ sman raka bsgron/ phyir spags la/ bh+yo bh+yoḥ pad+ma drag rtsal spyan snga ru// khas blangs dam du bcas pa yi// dkar mo lha yi bu mo bzhi// dmar mo gnod sbyin sring mo bzhi// nag mo bdud kyi bu mo bzhi// brtan ma chen mo bcu gnyis po// bran dang g.yog 'khor pho nyar bcas// 'dir gshegs sman raka gtor ma longs| |sngon gyi mna' chad ji lta bar// chos 'khor bstan pa gnyan po skyongs// rnal 'byor dpon slob sku tshe srings// mtha' dmag rkyen dang bar gcod zlog /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs gnod byed sgrol// mthun pa'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor spel// bcol ba'i las kun grub par mdzod// da sha dwi shā sa ni sa pa ri wā ra ba ling+ta a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gtsang sar phul nas gtor gzhong kha sbubs pa'i 'og tu dgra bgegs tshud par bsams la/ 'cham rngam dang ldan pa'i rta bro ni/ hūm̐ */ gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dgra bgegs tshogs// skye med chos dbyings drag por e// 'gag med ngang du mnan cing gzir// mtha' bral rang byung rtogs par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā a laṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ zhes rta bro bya zhing bshal chus bshal nas gtor gzhong sman 'brus bkang ngo*// de nas dngos grub blang ba ni/ gtor ma rang gi mgor bzhag sman raka myang zhing*/ hūm̐ */ bde mchog bde spyod nam mkha'i dkyil yangs na// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sras bcas thugs dam can// badz+ra gu ru pad+ma drag po rtsal// thugs bskyed dam dgongs dus 'dir brtse bas gzigs// bdag dang slob ma'i tshogs su bcas pa la// snang stong 'dzin bral sku yi dngos grub stsol// grag stong dbye bral gsung gi dngos grub stsol// gsal stong 'dzin bral thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// mtha' yas tshad med yon tan dngos grub stsol// phyogs med rab 'byams phrin las dngos grub stsol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes dang*/

tshogs byin rlabs kyi skabs kyi dngos grub kyi sngags 'dzab tu bzla zhing dngos grub blang ngo*// de nas bshags pa ni/ hoḥ ma hā gu ru drag po bdag la dgongs// ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur bdag cag gis// cho ga chad lhag nongs gyur sgrib pa'i tshogs// bzod par gsol zhing tshangs par myur bzhes la// sgrib med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol| |zhes dang*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis nongs pa bshags/ thun tha mar gshegs bsdu ni/ hūm̐ */ rang rig rang shar pad+ma drag po rtsal// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i dngos grub bstsal zin gyi// ji lta'i dus su slar yang 'byon par rigs// snang yul bskyed pa'i lha dang gzhal yas sogs// snang ba rang sems ngang du yal gyis bsdus// sems rig tha dad mnyam yangs don la blta// oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes rdzogs rim mtha' bral sems rig tha dad kyi don la mnyam par bzhag /de nas smon lam ni/ hūm̐ */ rang rig gsal stong bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du// gdod nas yongs grub lha yi sku sgom zhing*// rlung sngags dbyer med gsang sngags bzlas brjod dang*// sems rig tha dad a ti'i don sgom ni// dge ba 'dis mtshon mtha' yas 'gro ba rnams// nyon mongs sgrib pa'i nyes ltung kun zhi nas// rang rig don mthong bla ma'i sa thob shog /ces smon lam gdab/ shis pa brjod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ snang stong zung 'jug brjid ldan bla ma'i sku// gang 'dul sprul pa sku yi bkra shis shog /rlung sngags dbyer med hūm̐ sgra gsang sngags kyi// nges pa bdun ldan longs sku'i bkra shis shog /sems rig tha dad zab gsang rdzogs pa che// thugs 'phrad rang grol chos sku'i bkra shis shog /yon tan dpag yas pad+ma drag po rtsal// gu ru'i ngo bo sku yi bkra shis shog /phrin las mtha' yas 'gro la bu bzhin dgongs// pad 'byung thub dbang dbyer med bkra shis shog

/yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs dang*// mkha' 'gro ma sring dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bstan srung mthu rtsal bka' nyan dregs par bcas// sprul 'khor dag pa rab 'byams bkra shis shog /ces dang*/ gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ni ci rigs pa brjod par bya'o// de ltar yang gter gzhung las/ tshe gcig byang chub snying po bsgrub pa la// mdo rgyud bstan bcos nyan bshad 'khri ba chod// dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs kyi snying po 'di// bzlas pa tsam gyis chos nyid rang byung rtogs// zhes pa la sogs phan yon dpag tu med par gsungs pa'i bla ma tshe'i dbang po 'dzin pa'i gsang sgrub g.yu shog gi nang tshan du bzhugs par sgrub thabs tsam ma gtogs/ las gzhung gi spros pa ma mdzad par las gzhung sogs sgrub thabs la mkho ba rnams byang gter nas kha bkang dgos pas/ gter gzhung las/ las gzhung dag ni lha brag ma las bsgyur// zhes byang gter zang zang lha brag gi thugs sgrub nas rgyas 'debs dgos gu ru rin po che nyid kyis gsungs pa la brten rang bzo dang gzu lum ras gcod spangs shing lha brag ma'i las gzhung nyid sor bzhag nas/ de nyid kyi skabs la lar tshig tshogs ches pa rnams blo dman gyi nyams len bde ba'i phyir don gyi 'khrul pa med par tshig cha cung zad bsdus te sbyar ba yin gyi/ gzhan la la dag gis dgongs pa yang zab kyi gter gzhung gang yod la rtsom chos mi rung ba'i gnad kha gcig tu rang bzo'i spyi brtol gyi smyon ham gyi na'i bstan bcos byas pa yang kho bo chad du mthong yang*/ gnas de lta bu'i chos la rang bzo dang*/ gter gzhung la ngan lhad chu dang 'o ma bsres lhad lta bu gter srung rnams kyi chad pa'i gnas su gyur pa gor ma chag pa nyid du rigs so// de ltar tshe'i dbang po 'dzin pa bla ma'i gsang sgrub kyi las gzhung 'di yang mjing yon sad na legs kyi skye bar khas 'che ba 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong gnas lnga smra ba chos kyi grags pas/
gzhu smad spro lung gi kun dga' ra bar shing byi smin drug zla ba'i nyer lnga la sbyar bas g.yu shog ljang skya'i chos sder 'du'o// //sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:
